inputRootSignature: theorem leading_principal_component (n d : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (x : Fin n → Fin d → ℝ) (hcenter : ∑ i, x i = 0) (v : Fin d → Fin d → ℝ) (lambda : Fin d → ℝ) (horth : ∀ j k, dotProduct (v j) (v k) = if j = k then 1 else 0) (hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) = ⊤) : let S : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, vecMulVec (x i) (x i) let first : Fin d := ⟨0, by omega⟩ (∀ j, S *ᵥ v j = lambda j • v j) → Antitone lambda → (∀ j, j ≠ first → lambda first > lambda j) → let objective : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ := fun u ↦ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, (dotProduct u (x i)) ^ 2 {u : Fin d → ℝ | dotProduct u u = 1 ∧ ∀ w, dotProduct w w = 1 → objective w ≤ objective u} = {-v first, v first}
